name: smwpatches-beat-level-by-collecting-all-of-the-coins
title: Beat Level by Collecting All of the Coins
description:
This patch makes you win the level if you get all coins.
Notes:
- It doesn't count anything except object 05 when determining the number of coins in the level, but picking up Map16 tiles 2A, 2B, 2C and 132 will count as picking up a coin.
- Covered up instances of object 05 count.
- If you've got purple coins/etc. you want the player to grab, place object 05 behind them.
- To disable this patch in a level, hide some instances of object 05 behind a block.
